description: A step sequencer over a DNA strand: a typed pattern of nucleotide codes is expanded into a long gene, and stepping through it fires the outputs for whichever base the current position holds

params.text: Moves one base forward along the gene on each press
Moves one base backward along the gene on each press
Returns to the first base of the gene on each press

inputs.text: A rise moves one base forward along the gene
A rise moves one base backward along the gene
A rise returns to the first base of the gene

outputs.text: Fires when the current base is adenine
Fires when the current base is thymine
Fires when the current base is guanine
Fires when the current base is cytosine
Fires when the current base is a purine, which is adenine or guanine
Fires when the current base is a pyrimidine, which is cytosine or thymine
Fires on a strong base, which is cytosine or guanine
Fires on a weak base, which is adenine or thymine
Fires on anything other than cytosine
Fires on anything other than guanine
Fires on anything other than thymine
Fires on anything other than adenine
Fires a one-millisecond trigger on every step, whatever base it lands on
Carries a fixed voltage per base, set by the five sliders on the menu, and holds it until the next step
Carries the twelve base outputs at once as twelve polyphonic channels, in the order A, T, C, G, R, Y, S, W, D, H, V, B

notes: the gene comes from the pattern typed into the REPEAT PATTERN box, which takes IUPAC codes; an ambiguous code such as N is drawn at random for each position when the pattern changes
the pattern box is a text field rather than a control, so clicking it cannot reach a help entry
menu: Output Pulses instead of Gates — makes each base output a one-millisecond trigger rather than a gate that holds until the next step
Adenine Output Val — a slider setting the voltage the DNA output carries on an adenine, -10V to 10V
Thymine Output Val — a slider setting the voltage the DNA output carries on a thymine, -10V to 10V
Cytosine Output Val — a slider setting the voltage the DNA output carries on a cytosine, -10V to 10V
Guanine Output Val — a slider setting the voltage the DNA output carries on a guanine, -10V to 10V
Gap (X) Output Val — a slider setting the voltage the DNA output carries at a strand break, -10V to 10V
